apps.name: Blender in the Browser
apps.description: The real Blender, compiled to WebAssembly with a WebGPU backend (Puter Labs). Needs a WebGPU browser.
notes: Needs a browser with WebGPU. The first launch downloads about 200 MB, and the page reloads once while it sets itself up.

apps.name: Hew
apps.description: Free, open-source, solids-first 3D modeler in the SketchUp style. Opens SketchUp Make 2017 files.
apps.license: AGPL-3.0 with the Hew Plugin API Exception
notes: Opens .skp files saved by SketchUp Make 2017.
Hew also has native apps for macOS, Windows and Linux; this is its browser version.

apps.name: DraftDown
apps.description: Free, open-source 3D modeler with push/pull modeling for browser and desktop, built with React and Three.js.
notes: The project's repository has no license, so we keep no copy of it. This opens the author's own hosted app.
The author also publishes desktop apps for macOS, Windows and Linux.

apps.name: IngeTrazo
apps.description: Free, open-source 3D modeler for architecture, engineering and design, in the SketchUp style. Opens .skp files.
notes: Desktop only: there is no browser version. Download the installer for your system from the author's releases page.
Opens .skp files saved by SketchUp.
The author's manual is mostly in Spanish.
